newsitem.title: USA: Russell sees Q2 below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Russell sees Q2 below expectations.

text.p: Russell Corp said Thursday its earnings for the second quarter ending July 6 could be 50 percent below analysts' estimates and last year's record second quarter.
"More than half the earnings shortfall is the result of unfavorable conditions in our licensed products business," a news release issued by the company said.
Last year the company reported earnings per share of $0.42 for the second quarter.
Analysts had projected earnings of $0.41 per share for this year's second quarter, according to First Call.
Russell said sales volumes will likely fall 5-10 percent for the quarter, with the balance of the impact in the company's Jerzees brand.
Price erosion will be reflected by deteriorating gross margins, despite improvements in manufacturing efficiencies and favorable raw material cost comparisons, it said.
